findings.title: Material-grant loop in SetMaterialInternal ignores disallowConstructs
findings.detail: The removal loop at Hediff_Titan.cs:87-89 strips a disallowConstructs trait whenever stuff != null, even if the new material grants it. The add loop at Hediff_Titan.cs:93-95 then re-adds it with fromMaterial: true, because it only checks HasTrait and ConflictsWith. A material extension that lists a disallowConstructs trait therefore gets that trait on a construct anyway, removed and re-added (discovered reset to false) on every material change. Add `!def.disallowConstructs` to the add-loop condition at line 94, so the material path honours the flag the same way CanAddTrait does at TitanUtility.cs:75.

findings.title: Stale comment still says flesh-only traits are refused on a construct
findings.detail: InheritTraits sets the material first so that construct-disallowed traits get refused. After the split that is disallowConstructs, not requiresFlesh (which is now a race-only filter in AllowedOn). Reword the comment to match.

findings.title: "Of the deep" example may want disallowConstructs
findings.detail: Its description is 'regrows lost flesh' and it grants regeneration and naturalHealingFactor. The new doc comment frames disallowConstructs as being for traits that work through flesh-like things. Whether stone should regenerate is a design call; this is opinion only.
